realSampleAcquisition.audioNote: the audio is NOT committed: LibriSpeech (CC BY 4.0) would permit it, THCHS-30's two licence statements disagree, so neither is committed and the fetch script recreates both. dataset-sources.json records the first-hand licence text for each.

provenance.source: experiments/voice-trim/fixtures/ (8 authored clips, reused — the SPEC names this set) + 4 derived synthetic samples (AC5) + real human speech from LibriSpeech (CC BY 4.0) and THCHS-30 (AC2, P0.6)
provenance.nature: TTS-rendered dictation corpus, occupancy-tiered (en-e01-o45/o65, zh-d*-o85/o65/o45). The authored reference is the text the TTS was given (transcripts.json), so the ground truth is by construction, not model-labelled. Every TTS sample is synthetic:true. The 4 derived samples (AC5) are TTS audio re-cut — no human recording is fabricated. AC2 (P0.6) ADDS real human speech from licence-cleared corpora (LibriSpeech en / THCHS-30 zh), source:real, synthetic:false, each carrying its dataset, licence, speaker id where the corpus has one, sample rate, format, timestamps and fetch script; the real recordings are the ONLY source of human variability here — the synthetic ones cannot manufacture it.

self-correction.note: authored self-correction 嗯不对; the FIRST within-turn pause (the clause boundary before 嗯不对) is the correction point

annotationPolicy.unit: candidate point = the ONSET of a silence run inside one instruction, where every detector is asked END/CONTINUE
annotationPolicy.onset: the first frame whose RMS < SILENCE_RMS after a speech frame; the interrogation point for every group
annotationPolicy.withinTurnPause: a silence run of 250–1500 ms with speech after it ⇒ CONTINUE (the authored reference is a single instruction)
annotationPolicy.correction: a within-turn pause at an authored self-correction boundary ⇒ CORRECTION: a naive pipeline commits the superseded instruction, so the prediction is scored separately (must-supersede), never as a false cutoff
annotationPolicy.turnEnd: the onset of the trailing silence (the frame after the last speech frame) ⇒ END
annotationPolicy.excluded: silence runs > 1500 ms are recorded under excludedPauses and NOT scored — occupancy-injected gaps are ambiguous ground truth

sourceField.currentCorpus: P0.6: real human speech (LibriSpeech en CC BY 4.0 + THCHS-30 zh) plus the TTS corpus

annotationPolicy.realSampleFloor: real recordings are labelled with a PER-SAMPLE silence floor = max(0.001, 15th-percentile frame RMS), because the P0.6 measurement showed the synthetic corpus's absolute floor does not transfer to real room tone (see realSampleAcquisition); the floor used is recorded on every real sample under provenance.silenceFloor
annotationPolicy.asymmetry: the interrogation point is common but the reaction is not: StreamingVad can only answer after its own 400 ms of silence (so a pause ≥ 400 ms is a commit to END before the speaker resumes), while Smart Turn answers at the onset from the content of the preceding 8 s

sampleBreakdown.note: denominator = candidate POINTS (the unit every group answers), not clips
